lines: I’ll update the three release metadata files to describe the planned 0.1.0 release without implying it has shipped, keeping the changelog focused on the final public API.
cat AGENTS.md && cat CITATION.cff && cat SECURITY.md
git status --short && rg --files docs/coming-from-treams && sed -n '1,180p' README.md

The changelog is now a single unreleased 0.1.0 entry with capabilities, support limits and a migration table. I’m checking the final diff for stale names and publication claims; no release date or publishing status has been invented.
git diff --check -- CHANGELOG.md CITATION.cff SECURITY.md && git diff --stat -- CHANGELOG.md CITATI…
wc -l CHANGELOG.md CITATION.cff SECURITY.md && git status --short -- CHANGELOG.md CITATION.cff SECU…
